eyebrow.zh: Comino Test Drive · 原廠免費遠端評估
eyebrow.en: Comino Test Drive · Free remote evaluation

title.zh: 先跑你的工作負載，再決定配置。
title.en: Try your workload before choosing a configuration.

description.zh: 透過 Comino 原廠試用計畫，申請遠端評估 AMD Radeon PRO W7900、Radeon AI PRO R9700 與 ROCm 環境，確認 AI／HPC 工作負載的相容性與效能。
description.en: Apply through Comino’s official Test Drive program to remotely evaluate AMD Radeon PRO W7900, Radeon AI PRO R9700 and ROCm for your AI or HPC workload’s compatibility and performance.

body.zh: 在原廠表單說明使用情境、軟體與測試目的。
body.en: Describe your use case, software and evaluation goals in the official form.

body.zh: 符合資格者會收到 Comino 寄送的連線說明。
body.en: Qualifying applicants receive connection instructions from Comino by email.

title.en: Use results to plan your system

body.zh: 完成評估後，可與 EudTech 討論 GPU 配置、場地條件與報價。
body.en: After evaluation, discuss GPU configuration, site requirements and a quotation with EudTech.

terms.zh: 試用僅限評估，禁止將免費運算時間用於商業用途；Comino 保留隨時終止遠端存取的權利。試用資格、配置與開放時程以原廠確認為準。
terms.en: Evaluation only; commercial use of the free computing time is prohibited. Comino may revoke remote access at any time. Eligibility, configuration and availability are subject to Comino’s confirmation.

applyLabel.en: Apply for a free test drive

contactLabel.zh: 與 EudTech 討論測試需求
